limitations: Firefox broker runs outside the outer OS sandbox. Browser background/service traffic is therefore not covered by that OS outbound deny; this review does not approve or prove zero external browser background requests.

Playwright context.route provides HTTP request routing, not a complete transport firewall. It does not establish WebSocket or browser-internal traffic isolation; the reviewed script and inline fixture contain no WebSocket or other additional network API usage.

The Python sandbox permits any localhost destination and named host-read exclusions are not a complete host-read deny policy. Safety approval is for these inspected bytes and fixture, not arbitrary generated programs or sites.

The remote broker endpoint gives browser-control capability to its client. The exact reviewed generated script does not attempt to bypass the monkey-patched guards; the wrapper is not a security boundary for malicious replacement code.
